subject_uz: Radar sath o'lchagichlar, issiqlik va suv hisoblagichlari hamda analizatorlarni davriy qiyoslashdan o'tkazish xizmati

requirements.summary_uz: Xizmat ko'rsatuvchi tashkilot O'zDSt ISO 17025 yoki O'zDSt 3444 bo'yicha akkreditatsiyadan o'tgan kalibrlash laboratoriyasiga ega bo'lishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: The provider must have a calibration laboratory accredited to ISO 17025 or the national standard 3444.
requirements.quote: Xizmat ko`rsatuvchi tashkilot O`zDSt ISO 17025 yoki O`zDSt 3444 standarti asosida akkreditatsiyadan o`tgan

requirements.summary_uz: Ilovadagi o'lchash vositalari shartnomadan boshlab 90 kalendar kun ichida qiyoslanishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The instruments listed in the annex must be verified within 90 calendar days.
requirements.quote: 1- Ilovadagi o`lchash vositalarini 90 kalendar kuni ichida qiyoslashdan o`tkazish.

requirements.summary_uz: Texnologik qurilmaga o'rnatilgan va katta hajmli asboblar zavod hududiga kelib qiyoslanadi.
requirements.summary_en: Instruments installed in process units and large devices must be verified on the customer's plant site.
requirements.quote: Texnologiyada o’rnatilgan, katta hajmli va tekshiruv uchun texnologik jarayondagi muhit (gaz, suyuqlik yoki boshqa modda) talab qilingan o’lchash vositlarini zavod hududiga kelib qiyoslash.

requirements.summary_uz: Mutaxassislarning kelib-ketishi va laboratoriyaga olib borilgan asboblarni tashish xarajati ijrochi hisobidan.
requirements.summary_en: Travel of specialists and transport of instruments to the laboratory and back are at the contractor's cost.
requirements.quote: Laboratoriyaga olib borilishi zarur bo`lgan o`lchash vositalari Bajaruvchi hisobidan olib ketilib qaytarib olib

requirements.summary_uz: Har bir asbob uchun qiyoslash bayonnomalari va sertifikatlari qog'oz va elektron shaklda topshiriladi; yaroqsiz bo'lsa xabarnoma beriladi.
requirements.summary_en: For each instrument, verification reports and certificates are handed over on paper and electronically; a failure notice is issued if it fails.
requirements.quote: Kalibrlash natijalari, ya`ni har bor o`lchah vositasi uchun kalibrlash yoki qiyoslash bayonnomalari, kalibrlash sertifikatlari qog`oz va elektron shaklda buyurtmachiga topshirilishi.

requirements.summary_uz: Ijrochi axborot xavfsizligi bo'yicha ISO 27001 talablariga rioya qilishi va risklarni boshqarish tartibiga ega bo'lishi lozim.
requirements.summary_en: The contractor must follow ISO 27001 information-security requirements and have a risk-management procedure.
requirements.quote: ISO 27001 standartining (Ilova A) 5.18–5.22-bandlari talablariga muvofiq, Ijrochi kompaniya axborot xavfsizligi talablariga rioya qilishi

requirements.summary_uz: Har bir tajriba yozuvi shartnoma yoki dalolatnoma bilan tasdiqlanishi va unga aniq mos kelishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: Each experience entry must be backed by a contract or act and match it exactly.
requirements.quote: Har bir ish kamida bitta tasdiqlovchi hujjat (shartnoma, dalolatnoma yoki boshqa hujjat) bilan tasdiqlanishi va unga aniq mos kelishi shart

requirements.summary_uz: Baholash faqat narx bo'yicha (100 foiz); texnik taklif va hujjatlar mos bo'lsa 1 ball, aks holda diskvalifikatsiya.
requirements.summary_en: Evaluation is on price only (100 percent); a conforming technical offer and documents get 1 point, otherwise disqualification.
requirements.quote: 2-sonli shakl, 2-sonli shakl ilovasi va Texnik topshiriqda talab etilgan hujjatlar talablarga mos kelsa – 1 ball

requirements.summary_uz: Shartnoma imzolashda g'olib har bir xizmat narxini taqdim etadi; narx birlik uchun boshlang'ich narxdan oshmasligi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: At signing the winner states a price per service, which must not exceed the start price per unit.
requirements.quote: taklif etilgan narx tegishli birlik uchun belgilangan boshlang‘ich narxdan oshmasligi kerak

requirements.summary_uz: Davlat reyestri hujjatlari tekshiruv sanasidan kamida 30 kun oldin berilgan bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Documents from state registers must have been issued at least 30 days before the check date.
requirements.quote: davlat reestrlaridagi hujjatlar esa tekshirish sanasidan kamida 30 (o‘ttiz) kun oldin berilgan bo‘lishi kerak.

flags.quote: 1-izoh: zarurat bo‘lganda, tekshirish bosqichida talab qilinadigan hujjatlar ro‘yxati Buyurtmachi xodimining tashabbusi bilan kengaytirilishi mumkin.
flags.explanation_uz: Tekshirish bosqichida talab qilinadigan hujjatlar ro'yxati buyurtmachi xodimi tashabbusi bilan kengaytirilishi mumkin, 2-mezonda esa «salbiy xulosa» 0 ball va diskvalifikatsiyaga olib keladi. Takliflar muddatigacha ishtirokchi qaysi hujjat talab qilinishini bilmasligi va baholash mezoni noaniq bo'lishi mumkin. Lot narxi 900 094 000 so'm, narx bo'yicha baho 100 foiz.
flags.explanation_en: The list of documents required at the check stage may be extended at the initiative of a customer employee, and under criterion 2 a negative check result means 0 points and disqualification. A bidder cannot know in advance which documents will count, so the test is open-ended. The lot's start price is 900,094,000 UZS and evaluation is 100 percent on price.
flags.rewrite_uz: Tekshiruv uchun talab qilinadigan hujjatlar ro'yxati xarid hujjatida to'liq ko'rsatilsin; qo'shimcha hujjat talab qilinsa, ishtirokchiga kamida 3 ish kuni muddat berilsin.
flags.rewrite_en: List all documents required for the check in the procurement document; if an additional document is requested, give the bidder at least 3 working days to supply it.
